entities.name: Berk Uğurlu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Berk İbrahim Uğurlu is a Turkish professional basketball player for Beşiktaş Gain of the Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL) and the EuroCup. Standing at 1.92 m, and weighing 87 kg (192 lbs.), he plays at the point guard position.
